_comment: Shared by sdk-python/tests/test_argument_checks.py and sdk-typescript/tests/argument-checks.test.ts: search timestamp bounds each SDK refuses before any request ("refused"), and ones it sends as written ("sent"). A string is checked and sent as written; a datetime / Date is sent in UTC, so its UTC instant must fall in years 0001-9999: each "refusedAsDates" string, parsed into the native date (datetime.fromisoformat / new Date) and passed as that object, is refused before any request.
